description: Synthetic: built from the Redsys hub's TPP technical design (v1.9.4) and its BBVA sandbox page, not recorded. Replace with a live recording once the sandbox account exists. Connect to BBVA (aspsp given in lower case, sent as the hub spells it): the OAuth pre-step (authorize with scope AIS and PKCE; the code exchanged for a token), a global consent created on v1.1 with the token, the consent approved by a second redirect, then scaStatus, the consent and the accounts with balances, all with the bearer token.
